statement_html:
We suppose that each time we toss a coin, the probability of obtaining face up is exactly 1/2.

If we toss 40 times the coin, what is the probability of obtaining exactly 14 times the face up?

Entrez votre réponse :
=
solution_html: There are \(C_40^{14}\) distinct	  ways for the 14 faces to be distributed among the 40 tosses	 of the coin. And each particular distribution has a probability of	 \(1/2^{40}\).
